thread.title: Stocks end higher, as Dow posts 6th gain in a row - MarketWatch

author: Anneken Tappe
title: Stocks end higher, as Dow posts 6th gain in a row - MarketWatch
text: U.S. stock benchmarks Thursday finished the day broadly higher, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.80% booked a 6th straight advance -- equaling its longest win streak in more than two months. Better-than-expected jobless claims and a slower pace of inflation supported equities, as particularly the latter suggested the Federal Reserve won't increase the pace of its monetary policy normalization any time soon. The Dow ended 0.8% higher at 24,739. The S&P 500 SPX, +0.93% ended 0.9% higher at 2,723, marking a second day of gains, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.89% had its fifth straight day of closing higher, ending up 0.9% at 7,405. In individual stocks, tech giant Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.43% rose 1.3% and hit a new record high.
